verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a full export, including scheduled automated exports, in which properties become front matter and collections become CSV files, described as human- and machine-readable for reuse in other apps. The format is implied to be Markdown with front matter, but the export doc excerpts never name Markdown explicitly. JSON export is not documented, and native storage is a synced app database rather than open files. missing for 10: explicit statement that notes export as Markdown, a JSON export option, documented specification of the export file structure, native open-format storage, independent or hands-on corroboration of export fidelity.

support.subject: As a researcher, my notes are stored or exportable in open, documented formats (Markdown, JSON) so my archive outlives the vendor

citations.quote: All your properties are transformed into front matter values, all collections are stored as CSV files, making it easy to reuse your content in other apps or work with it programmatically.
Exports from Capacities are fully human- and machine-readable at the same time.
You can schedule automatic exports by going to `Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule`.
